title: Cloud and Storage Integration
description: Azure, AWS, and cloud storage SDKs for .NET Core applications.
longDescription: This module covers essential cloud integration packages for .NET Core, including Azure and AWS SDKs, and cloud storage clients.
whatYouLearn: Store files in Azure Blob Storage
Use Amazon S3 for object storage
Securely store secrets in Azure Key Vault
Send messages with Azure Service Bus
Ingest events with Azure Event Hubs
Run MinIO for local S3-compatible storage
